# AI Coding Masterclass — 2026

**Created by School of AI**

> Use AI to engineer better software—not merely generate more code.

**Context → Prompt → Plan → Implement → Test → Debug → Refactor → Review → Secure → Commit → Deploy → Evaluate**

20 modules, 80 tutorials, 20 labs, 20 projects, 12 cases, 18 templates, 160 quiz questions, 60-question final, 6 notebooks, prompt library, local utilities, CI and a brownfield capstone.

## Core principles

**AI-generated code is untrusted code until it is understood, tested and reviewed.**

**The unit of progress is not code generated. It is verified behavior delivered.**

The course is tool-neutral and works with coding assistants, IDE/terminal agents, local models and enterprise coding tools.
